title: Promised delivery day missed after vehicle breakdown
snapshot: Dispatch confirms that vehicle fault V-12 ended DL-012's route at 08:20 UTC on 2026-02-12, so the 08:00–09:00 window was missed and the parcel is back in depot custody. Fenn Azel, the recipient, asks for a replacement slot and is free on the afternoon of 2026-02-14.
recorded_action: Iona emailed Dispatch to rebook DL-012 after the confirmed breakdown for the afternoon of 2026-02-14 and to confirm a specific window and any charge.

negatives.label: Booking tool timed out on reservation

new_event.text: We tried to reserve an afternoon window on 2026-02-14 for DL-012. The booking tool timed out before showing a confirmation. We cannot see whether the reservation saved and have sent nothing to Fenn.

negatives.expected_action: Ask Dispatch by email to read the saved booking record for DL-012 and report whether a 2026-02-14 reservation exists, with no second reservation until that is known.
negatives.must_not: Do not ask Dispatch to try the booking again straight away, which could create two reservations, and do not tell Fenn that a slot is booked.
negatives.done_means: Dispatch reports one saved window or none, and if none, one resubmission is confirmed once; this closes the rebooking question, not delivery.

agent_event.text: Please read the saved booking record for DL-012 and tell us whether any 2026-02-14 reservation exists after the booking tool timed out. Please do not create a second reservation until we know. If none is saved, we will ask for one reservation within Fenn's 2026-02-14 afternoon availability.

followup_event.text: The saved record for DL-012 shows one reservation: 2026-02-14, 13:00–16:00 UTC, no extra charge, created at 09:38 UTC. No second reservation exists. We have not yet sent the booking to Fenn. This closes the rebooking question, not delivery.

negatives.label: Afternoon capacity filled before booking

new_event.text: Afternoon capacity on 2026-02-14 was filled at 09:30 UTC, before we reached your request. Available instead: 2026-02-14, 09:00–12:00 UTC, or 2026-02-15, 14:00–17:00 UTC. Neither carries a charge. Nothing is reserved yet.

negatives.expected_action: Ask Fenn in the Customer portal to choose between 2026-02-14, 09:00–12:00 UTC and 2026-02-15, 14:00–17:00 UTC, both without charge, and pass only that choice to Dispatch.
negatives.must_not: Do not book the 2026-02-14 morning window because the date matches; Fenn offered only the afternoon.
negatives.done_means: Fenn chooses one window and Dispatch confirms the reservation; this is a booking, not a delivery.

agent_event.text: Dispatch has no afternoon capacity left on 2026-02-14. They can offer 2026-02-14, 09:00–12:00 UTC, or 2026-02-15, 14:00–17:00 UTC, both without charge. Nothing is reserved yet. Which window should we ask them to book?

followup_event.text: Fenn's choice, relayed by you at 10:25 UTC, is reserved: DL-012, 2026-02-15, 14:00–17:00 UTC, no extra charge. We have sent the revised booking to Fenn. This is a booking, not a delivery.

negatives.label: Dispatch silent before next-day window

new_event.text: I have heard nothing about tomorrow afternoon. Is DL-012 booked or not? I will only keep the afternoon free if someone confirms a window today.

negatives.expected_action: Send Dispatch one email reminder asking for a specific 2026-02-14 afternoon window and any charge before the end of today, record Dispatch as owner, and tell Fenn in the portal that no window is confirmed yet.
negatives.must_not: Do not tell Fenn that DL-012 is booked for tomorrow afternoon; a reminder to Dispatch is not a booking.
negatives.done_means: Dispatch confirms a specific window and charge, or the missed deadline is recorded against Dispatch; neither is a delivery.

agent_event.text: Reminder on DL-012: please send a specific 2026-02-14 afternoon window and any charge before the end of today, 2026-02-13. Fenn Azel will keep tomorrow afternoon free only if a window is confirmed today. Without it, Fenn may not be home and the replacement attempt could fail again.

followup_event.text: Replacement booking for DL-012: 2026-02-14, 13:00–16:00 UTC, no extra charge. We have reserved capacity and sent the revised booking to Fenn. This is a booking, not a delivery.

negatives.label: Recipient withdraws the rebooking request

new_event.text: Please stop the rebooking for DL-012. I have asked the seller to cancel the order and refund me. I do not want another delivery attempt.

negatives.expected_action: Record the stop with Dispatch by email, forbid any new booking for DL-012, and ask what had already been reserved or sent to Fenn before the stop.
negatives.must_not: Do not request a return to sender or promise Fenn a refund; the seller owns the cancellation and refund, and a return is a separate step.
negatives.done_means: Dispatch confirms the stop and reports the actual state of DL-012; this does not cancel the order, start a return or establish a refund.

agent_event.text: Fenn Azel has asked us to stop the rebooking of DL-012 and does not want another delivery attempt. Please record the stop and make no new booking for DL-012. What, if anything, was reserved or sent to Fenn before this message? The seller handles any order cancellation and refund.

followup_event.text: Stop recorded for DL-012 at 10:05 UTC. No replacement booking had been reserved and nothing was sent to Fenn. The parcel stays in depot custody. This does not cancel the order, start a return or establish a refund.

negatives.label: Recipient asks for unoffered arrival time

new_event.text: I got the 14:00–17:00 booking for tomorrow. I can only be home from 16:00. Can the driver come at 16:30 instead?

negatives.expected_action: Ask Dispatch by email whether a window from 16:00 UTC on 2026-02-14 is available and at what charge, keeping the current booking unchanged until Fenn accepts an offered option.
negatives.must_not: Do not promise Fenn a 16:30 arrival, and do not cancel the 14:00–17:00 booking before Dispatch offers an alternative.
negatives.done_means: Dispatch quotes an available window and Fenn accepts it in the portal; until then the 14:00–17:00 booking stands, and neither proves delivery.

agent_event.text: Fenn Azel can only be home from 16:00 UTC on 2026-02-14 and asks for a 16:30 arrival. Is any window starting from 16:00 UTC on 2026-02-14 available, and at what charge? Please keep the current 14:00–17:00 UTC booking unchanged until Fenn accepts an offered option.

followup_event.text: We can offer DL-012 on 2026-02-14, 16:00–19:00 UTC, at no extra charge. We cannot promise a 16:30 arrival. The 14:00–17:00 UTC booking stays in place until Fenn accepts the new window. Nothing has been changed yet, and neither window proves delivery.

negatives.label: Customer notice shows a different window

new_event.text: The revised booking I received says 2026-02-14, 08:00–11:00 UTC, not the afternoon. I asked for the afternoon. Which one is right?

negatives.expected_action: Keep both records and ask Dispatch by email which window is saved in the DL-012 booking record and to correct the notice sent to Fenn, telling Fenn only that the window is being checked.
negatives.must_not: Do not tell Fenn that the afternoon window is correct because Dispatch's email says so, or that the notice can be ignored.
negatives.done_means: Dispatch confirms one saved window and reissues a matching notice; this settles the booking record, not delivery.

agent_event.text: Fenn Azel received a revised booking notice for DL-012 showing 2026-02-14, 08:00–11:00 UTC, while your email confirms 14:00–17:00 UTC. We are keeping both records. Which window is saved in the DL-012 booking record? If the notice is wrong, please reissue a corrected notice to Fenn.

followup_event.text: The DL-012 booking record holds one window: 2026-02-14, 14:00–17:00 UTC, no extra charge. The 08:00–11:00 notice was sent in error and is withdrawn. We reissued a matching notice to Fenn at 10:40 UTC. This settles the booking record, not delivery.
